multi_entity_note: Single receipt for one purchase transaction from one merchant.

receipt.subtotal_price.rationale: The value 36000 printed under the Sub Total label is the subtotal; the earlier 36000s are the item price and line amount.

receipt.discount_price.rationale: Only a discount rate (0%) is printed, no discount amount.

receipt.menuqty_cnt.rationale: No total item count is printed; the only quantity is the single line-item quantity 1.
